text:
alex: Quick heads-up — I'm going to apply a safelock change to config-operator that prevents concurrent applies during snapshot restores. Want an ops handoff and to lock down telemetry before I flip it.
priya: SG. Which signals are you planning to expose? error-rate + apply-duration? :eyes:
dan: +1. We should emit a "config.apply.safelock_acquired" counter and a span for the apply lifecycle. That lets SRE alert on stuck applies.
emily: Also add an audit event to the per-tenant timeline (so customers' audits show an attempted apply + safelock outcome). Last time we lost traceability on rollbacks.
alex: plan: 1) add metrics (counter/gauge/histogram) 2) add audit event 3) wire console to show safelock state in the preview panel 4) feature flag rollout (start with 0.1 cohort) 5) dry-run window for 24h. Command I'm testing locally: ```./configctl apply --safelock --snapshot=2026-03-22T09:00Z --dry-run```
priya: For telemetry contract, let's require: metric names, tag keys (tenant_id, operator_version), and an open schema for the span attributes. I'll draft a tiny contract doc and push a PR.
dan: Ops: we should have an automatic rollback if a single apply exceeds 10m or if the histogram tail spikes 5x baseline. Can we implement a short-circuit via router?
emily: Console UX: show a small banner when safelock is active for tenant, with a link to the audit event and the dry-run diff. Also expose a manual override toggle only for SRE with audit.
alex: I'm going to create the PR now. tagging @priya and @dan for review. Will schedule a canary rollout to 10 tenants first.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: deployment scheduled for config-operator-canary at 2026-03-22T16:00Z to cluster-canary-2. CI green. :white_check_mark:
priya: tiny nit — ensure the metric uses unit ms for duration and we document sample-rates for high-frequency tenants.
dan: I'll add the alert runbook snippets. If it triggers, we want a playbook step: 'pause canary' -> 'inspect locks' -> 'force-release if safe'.
alex: ack. timeline: PR today, merge after reviews, dry-run 24h, canary to 10 tenants for 48h, then ramp. If any of the telemetry gates fail, auto-pause and notify #eng-oncall.
emily: assign owners: @alex for implementation, @priya for telemetry contract, @dan for alerting/runbook, SRE to own the override flow.
alex: thanks — will post PR link when ready. :rocket:
